facts.text: The Industrial Designer judged the idea of a partly-wooden remote control interesting.

relations.text: Wood is presented as special/high-class in contrast to plastic, which is described as merely resistant and more common.

relations.text: The Project Manager's fashion-in-electronics rationale for using wood is what the Industrial Designer responded to by agreeing that only part of the case need be wooden and calling the idea interesting — a provisional expression of interest within this evidence, not a firm, finalized decision.

corpus_defect_notes: The native reference_answer states the group 'decided' to use wood partly instead of plastic, but the native_evidence provided for this case (span:0 and span:1) only shows the team characterizing a partial-wood case as 'interesting' ('Mm okay , seems to be interesting , mm .') rather than recording an explicit, firm decision statement within those spans. A more definite confirmation ('So wood.', 'so maybe we can stay with wood.') appears later in the full source.md transcript, outside the two evidence spans supplied for this case.
